gate1_parse.load_warning: UserWarning: the type definition character '%' was declared on 132 phases but no corresponding TYPE_DEFINITION line exists in the TDB. The character is inert for this database.

gate2_model_structure.impact_rationale: The disabled BCC_B2 order/disorder coupling, the missing MC/MX composition sets and the absent HMVA parameters change the model. Their effect on the B-DQ/R-DQ target window could not be quantified, so 'no effect' is explicitly NOT claimed.

diff_audit.comparison_basis: normalised comparison of the shared thermodynamic parameter set, with an explicit classifier; the author's 'no parameter changes' claim was not accepted as evidence
diff_audit.cleaned_block_reassembled: 77 '$ Cleaned by script:' comment lines reassembled into 35 statements; all 35 matched upstream statements

independent_validation.crash_isolation: Every equilibration runs in its own subprocess with a wall-clock timeout, because pycalphad 0.11.2 can abort the process natively instead of raising.

community_binary_claims.note: Fe-Cr, Fe-Ni, Fe-Ti, Fe-Mo and Ni-Ti criteria were re-implemented from the stated conditions; no author image, conclusion or source code was used.
community_binary_claims.grid: 9 composition points (x = 0.01..0.99) x 13 temperatures (500-1890 K), phases limited to the phases named for each system

project_relevant_checks.observed_assemblages_note: Cementite is metastable when graphite is present, so the Fe-C system is evaluated twice: the stable system is checked for graphite, and cementite is checked with graphite suspended. M7C3/M23C6 appear in the Fe-Cr-C system.
project_relevant_checks.what_this_proves: Software behaviour and basic thermodynamic plausibility only. It is NOT experimental validation of a steel grade and must never be reported as such.

model_loss_probe.conclusion: No separate MC/MX phase exists in the derivative, so Nb/Ti/V carbo-nitride fractions cannot be resolved by pycalphad. The consequence for the target window is classified unknown_model_impact.

solver_capacity_limit.finding: pycalphad 0.11.2 in this environment cannot solve an equilibrium whose component list holds more than 13 entries.
solver_capacity_limit.phase_list_independence_evidence: The abort reproduces with a single-phase list and with a two-phase list, so the limit is not caused by the 132-phase database.
solver_capacity_limit.point_density_independence_evidence: The abort reproduces at pdens = 10, 50, 200 and 2000.
solver_capacity_limit.component_identity_independence_evidence: The 14th component was varied across B, N, P, S, Co, Ta, Y, W and Hf; every one aborted, so no single element is responsible.

control_experiment.database: pycalphad-bundled COST507.tdb (independent of the community derivative)
control_experiment.conclusion: The identical boundary on an independent database shows this is an environment/software limitation, not a defect introduced by the community derivative.

Workspace construction succeeds; the abort happens in the first solve (workspace.get / equilibrium)

solver_capacity_limit.project_sample_impact: Both project heats need 16 component entries, so the phase-fraction curve cannot be produced in this environment.
solver_capacity_limit.product_behaviour: The adapter fails closed: status failed, state blocked, code CALPHAD-RUN-001, and the worker reports CALPHAD-WORKER-MEMORY-001 with the measured capacity limit. No component was dropped, no phase was dropped and no default value was substituted.
solver_capacity_limit.required_decision: Reducing the component system, restricting the phase list or repairing the isolated environment all change the scientific claim. Each requires a named owner decision and a versioned update of the controlled element exclusion policy.

status.reason: The candidate parses, the diff audit found only syntax repairs, and the community and project plausibility checks reproduced. However the two project heats cannot be solved in this environment, so the phase-3 verification is incomplete and the feature cannot produce a result for a real sample.
